task.description: WF-02, step 04e — both gates passed on pass 2 (REVIEWER step 04d, SECURITY-REVIEWER step 04c), but with Low findings in the new code that ORCH wants fixed before the tests are written, so that no test pins a wrong behaviour. Fix in tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js: (1) L5 of REVIEWER: the timeout options accept only whole numbers from 1 to 2147483647 ms (Node cuts a longer timer to 1 ms, so a larger value made the start fail at once with a message about a time that never passed); a value outside that range, 0 included, is refused with USAGE before anything is started, and the message names the range; the message for a cwd with a NUL says 'without NUL' in the same shape as the message for args; (2) F5 of SECURITY-REVIEWER: the branch for a child that ended before its link builds STAND_START_EXITED from the end of the process with a guard (no end seen: code and signal null), so that a child that emits close without exit (possible only through an injected deps.spawn) gives the kit's error and the same clean-up, never a TypeError. Fix in the starter comment of stand.js and in the starter paragraph of tools/README.md: (3) L6 = F6: 'nothing else' is not quite true — say that the system and Node may add variables of their own (macOS adds __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING; Node passes NODE_V8_COVERAGE on when the spec process has it), none of them given by the starter; in the README keep every existing word of the paragraph (add a clause, do not remove or reword), run prettier on README.md. Nothing else changes. Prove each fix outside the project with a trial that fails on the current code and passes on yours (the trials of the reviewers in the session scratchpad may be reused); re-run your own trials of step 04b on the fixed code; then from tools/: npm run -s format:check, npm run -s lint, npm run -s traces | tail -1, npm run -s handoffs-check | tail -1, node --test test/e2e-kit.test.js | tail -8 (still only E2K-50 red), and the real picker through the starter (check (a) of section 14 of the design). Task text and files hold no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects. Do not edit any test file; do not commit or push.
acceptance_criteria: L5: timeouts 1..2147483647 only, range named; cwd NUL message
L6/F6: comment and README say the platform may add variables; README words kept

issues.text: E2K-50 (tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js) stays red with 'test/e2e/kit/stand.js: reads TEMP' until TEST-DESIGNER adds the six names at sub-step 3 (section 12 row 1); this step did not touch the base list, and the copy without this step is red with the same message. No existing test checks what changed here. New behaviour for TEST-DESIGNER (sub-steps 3-4), besides I1 of step 04b: (a) startTimeoutMs and stopTimeoutMs of 0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity and 2147483648 give USAGE '<option> must be a whole number of milliseconds from 1 to 2147483647' with 0 spawns and no folder, and 2147483647 is accepted; (b) a cwd that is empty, not a string or holds a NUL gives 'cwd must be a non-empty path without NUL'; (c) a deps.spawn child that sends close alone gives STAND_START_EXITED '(exit code null)' with exitCode and signal null, nothing registered and no marker; (d) L6 changes text only (E2S-05 already allows __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING; NODE_V8_COVERAGE as I3 of step 03 says).

The sibling of F5 in stop(), not in the list and so not edited (AP-019): once the group is gone, #doStop waits for state.exited with no limit (stand.js:207-210). A real child always sends exit by then, but a fake child of deps.spawn that never sends exit makes stop() wait forever: measured with a fake child of pid 999999 that printed its link (t-f5.mjs (C), the same on both copies: stop() still waiting after 3012-3015 ms, stopTimeoutMs 300). For TEST-DESIGNER: a fake child must send exit (then close), as Node does. ORCH decides whether this wait needs a limit; Low, a test seam only.

The L5 kind outside the write set (AP-014): the timeout options of the released kit are not checked at all, so a value above 2147483647 also fires after 1 ms there (and 0, NaN or a string pass through): launchBrowser of browser.js (startTimeoutMs, callTimeoutMs, closeGraceMs), connect of cdp.js (callTimeoutMs), goto, reload and waitFor of page.js (timeoutMs, pollMs), runAll of runner.js (fileTimeoutMs, killGraceMs), installHandlers of cleanup.js (hookLimitMs). Low: the callers are the kit's own specs and tests. Not edited; ORCH decides whether DOC-UPDATER opens a defect.

The message shape of L3 and L5 that stays in stand.js, not in the list: 'the options must be an object' (line 60) and 'env must be an object' (line 98) are also the answers for an array, which is an object in JavaScript; the rule broken is 'a plain object, not a list'. Low; not edited (AP-019).

Design texts that now lag behind the code and the README (AP-005), outside the write set, for DOC-UPDATER at step 10 (with REVIEWER I2 of step 04d and I4 of step 04b): section 10 item 3 of docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md, the source text of README line 844, now lacks three clauses (O14, O15, L6); section 6 row 'The child sees no foreign variable' is imprecise in the way of L6 (the platform's own names reach the child); 4.1 lacks the reading of O14, the range of the two timeouts (1…2147483647) and the unknown end of STAND_START_EXITED ('exit code null'); section 15 row R2 as I4 (c) of step 04b says.

L6 (a text that says 'only' or 'nothing else' about the child's environment) - the design row of I5; no other such text in tools/.
